<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

cur = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
Lcols = [17,20,23,26,29,32,35,38,41,44]
Opos = [(17,19),(17,23),(17,26),(17,29),(17,32),(17,35),(17,38),(20,35),(23,35),(26,35),(29,35),(32,35),(35,35),(38,35),(41,35),(44,35),(44,32),(44,29),(44,26),(44,23),(41,23),(38,23),(35,23),(32,23),(29,23),(26,23),(23,23),(20,23)]
def parse(fr):
    O=''.join(fr[r][c] for r,c in Opos); L=''.join(fr[26][c] for c in Lcols); M=''.join(fr[35][c] for c in Lcols)
    return (O,L,M)
def shift(t,d,skip=()):
    order=[i for i in range(len(t)) if i not in skip]; m=len(order); out=list(t)
    for k,p in enumerate(order): out[order[(k+d)%m]]=t[p]
    return out
def norm(O,L,M):
    O=list(O);L=list(L);M=list(M)
    O[9]=L[6];O[25]=L[2];O[12]=M[6];O[22]=M[2]
    return (O,L,M)
def step(st,a):
    O,L,M=st
    if a==0: O=shift(O,-1,(0,6))
    elif a==1: O=shift(O,1,(0,6))
    elif a==2: L=shift(L,-1)
    elif a==3: L=shift(L,1)
    elif a==4: M=shift(M,-1)
    elif a==5: M=shift(M,1)
    return norm(O,L,M)
start=norm(*parse(cur))
plan=[1,1,5,1,1,1,5,5,5]
st=start
exp=[]
for a in plan:
    st=step(st,a); exp.append(st)
print("start O:",start[0])
for i,(a,s) in enumerate(zip(plan,exp)):
    print(i+1,"O9,O12:",s[0][9],s[0][12]," YposO:",[j for j in range(28) if s[0][j]=='Y']," YposL:",[j for j in range(10) if s[1][j]=='Y']," YposM:",[j for j in range(10) if s[2][j]=='Y'])
# execute first batch: two N clicks

print("batch done, board_changed:",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
after=norm(*parse(current_frame.ascii.split('\n')))
print("expected after 2N O:",exp[1][0])
print("actual after 2N O:  ",after[0])
print("match:",after[0]==exp[1][0] and after[1]==exp[1][1] and after[2]==exp[1][2])
